Home Health Agency (HHA) Enrollments Data Dictionar            y
       Term Name                    Variable Name                                             Description                                      Type      Length
 Enrollment ID                ENROLLMENT ID                     HHA’s enrollment ID.                                                          CHAR          15
                                                                An enrollment ID is a unique 15-digit alphanumeric identifier
                                                                that is assigned to each new provider enrollment application.
                                                                All enrollment-level information (          e.g., enrollment type,
                                                                enrollment state, provider specialty and reassignment of
                                                                benefits) is linked through the enrollment ID.
 Enrollment State             ENROLLMENT STATE                  HHA’s enrollment state, see State Code Reference Table for                    CHAR           2
                                                                description of values.
 Provider Type Code           PROVIDER TYPE CODE                Enrollment application and specialty type code, see Provider                  CHAR           5
                                                                Type Code Reference Table for the full list of Part A provider
                                                                types.
 Provider Type Text           PROVIDER TYPE TEXT                Description for Provider Type Code.                                           CHAR         200
 NPI                          NPI                               HHA’s National Provider Identifier (NPI).                                     CHAR          10
                                                                An NPI is a unique 10-digit numeric identifier that all
                                                                providers must obtain before enrolling in Medicare. It is
                                                                assigned to healthcare providers upon application through
                                                                the National Plan and Provider Enumeration System
                                                                (NPPES).
 Multiple NPI Flag            MULTIPLE NPI FLAG                 A flag that indicates whether the HHA has more than 1 NPI                     CHAR           1
                                                                (Y/N). If yes, additional NPIs are displayed in the HHA
                                                                Additional NPIs file.
 CCN                          CCN                               HHA’s CMS Certification Number (CCN), formerly called an                      CHAR          15
                                                                OSCAR Number.
 Associate ID                 ASSOCIATE ID                      HHA’s PECOS Associate Control (PAC) ID.                                       CHAR          10
                                                                A PAC ID is a unique 10-digit numeric identifier that is
                                                                assigned to each individual or organizational provider in
                                                                PECOS. All entity-level information (          e.g., Tax Identification
                                                                Numbers and provider names) is linked through the PAC ID.
                                                                A PAC ID may be associated with multiple enrollment IDs if
                                                                the provider is enrolled multiple times under different
                                                                circumstances.
 Organization Name            ORGANIZATION NAME                 HHA’s legal business name.                                                    CHAR          70
 Doing-Business-As            DOING BUSINESS AS                 HHA’s doing-business-as name.                                                 CHAR          70
 Name                         NAME
 Incorporation Date           INCORPORATION DATE                Date on which the business is incorporated.                                    NUM           8
 Incorporation State          INCORPORATION STATE               State in which the business is incorporated, see State Code                   CHAR           2
                                                                Reference Table for description of values.
 Organization Type            ORGANIZATION TYPE                 HHA’s organization structure type.                                            CHAR          60
 Structure                    STRUCTURE
 Organization Other           ORGANIZATION OTHER                Description of the organization structure if Organization Type                CHAR          60
 Type Text                    TYPE TEXT                         Structure is “OTHER”.
 Proprietary/Nonprofit        PROPRIETARY_NONPROFIT             “P” if the business is registered as proprietor with the IRS;                 CHAR           1
 Flag                                                           "N" if registered as nonprofit.
 Address Line 1               ADDRESS LINE 1                    Address line 1 of the HHA’s practice location address.                        CHAR          55
 Address Line 2               ADDRESS LINE 2                    Address line 2 of the HHA’s practice location address.                        CHAR          55
 City                         CITY                              City of the HHA’s practice location address.                                  CHAR          30
 State                        STATE                             State of the HHA’s practice location address, see State Code                  CHAR           2
                                                                Reference Table for description of values.
 Zip Code                     ZIP CODE                          Zip code of the HHA’s practice location address.                              CHAR          15
 Practice Location            PRACTICE LOCATION                 Type of practice location.                                                    CHAR          32
 Type                         TYPE
 Location Other Type          LOCATION OTHER TYPE               Other type of practice location found in the CMS-855 form.                    CHAR          60
 Text                         TEXT
